gen-nixie-one-gf-ruluko: Ruluko reads friendly and broad, its rounded bowls wide enough to let light in. And Nixie One, drawn with a single unvarying line, adds a retro-tech hum that the body never tries to match.
gen-nixie-one-gf-sansation: Sansation reads approachable and smooth, with curves that turn inward without any dark pooling of ink where they bend. Nixie One's retro line stays uniform.
gen-nixie-one-gf-sarabun: Thin and nostalgic, true monoline lettering up top. But Sarabun follows with a wide channel into every bowl, and that gap between a drawn-wire heading and a roomy body is what makes the pair work.
gen-nixie-one-gf-sarala: Contemporary is the mood Sarala sets, with distinct gaps in its c, e and s that keep every word easy to separate. And Nixie One above it, with a stroke like neon glass tubing, adds a retro glow without crowding the text.
gen-nixie-one-gf-sawarabi-gothic: Sawarabi Gothic keeps its jaws open on every curve. Nixie One's stroke never changes weight, so the heading skims along with a nostalgic ease that the lightly modulated body quietly sets off.
gen-nixie-one-gf-shanti: Shanti gives the e a generous entry, so the modern, professional text feels easy to enter. Shanti keeps that openness going line after line, while Nixie One above it draws everything like a ballpoint pen.
gen-nixie-one-gf-shippori-antique: Retro wire meets modern monoweight, with Nixie One's open curves leading and Shippori Antique following with bowls tipped toward you like a ladle. One is made to be admired, the other made to be read.
gen-nixie-one-gf-shippori-antique-b1: Nostalgic outlines above, modern daylight below, since Nixie One's open curves lead into a body with visible space in every curve. Shippori Antique B1 holds the line with its stencil-brush plainness, built to be read, while the heading is built to be noticed.
gen-nixie-one-gf-sn-pro: Nixie One opens with a nostalgic, retro-tech feel and contrast-free strokes. If the heading shrinks too small, those hairline-light lines may fade, while SN Pro's open apertures keep the modern sans-serif body readable at any size.
gen-nixie-one-gf-snippet: Approachable is the first word for Snippet, whose c opens wide like a crescent wrench. Snippet's wire-bent look runs across each word, which echoes the constant stroke of Nixie One and links the two.
